name: Mango-habanero glaze
status: PRELIMINARY ESTIMATE — NOT COOKED OR TASTED

lines.prep: deseeded, minced; heat is the main test variable
slurried in 20 ml cold water (water cost negligible)

method: Simmer puree, habanero, garlic, ginger, jaggery, lime juice, vinegar and salt, stirring, until reduced by about 30% (target about 450 g from 637 g).
Whisk in the cornstarch slurry; boil 1 minute; the glaze should coat the back of a spoon and hold a drawn line.
Cool fast (see food safety); hold cold; rewarm to 70 °C or above before tossing to order.

sauce_spec.heat: medium-high; start at 12 g deseeded habanero per batch and adjust per test
sauce_spec.use: Mango Habanero Gobi finish; about 55 g per portion

food_safety: Cool from 57 °C to 21 °C within 2 hours and to 5 °C within a further 4 hours (US Food Code cooling rule; the written HACCP plan governs): shallow pans, ice bath.
Reheat to 74 °C (165 °F) for hot holding if it has been cooled; never top up an old batch.
Wear gloves for habanero; wash tools; keep eyes/skin contact in mind for staff.
test_variables: glaze viscosity vs crunch retention at T+10
evidence: food/CORE5-FOOD-MATRIX.csv (gobi-taco row: mango-habanero glaze, ORIGINAL HOUSE COMPOSITION, formulation not locked)
